name: 48653 · Roscommon, MI
findings: ZIP 48653 (Roscommon) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48653 (Roscommon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48653 (Roscommon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
